title: Visual builder layers copy paste inline autosave

entries.summary: Layers tree with hover-to-canvas preview and close control; in-place heading/text edit; Copy/Paste toolbar plus Ctrl/Cmd+C/X/V; insert-after module; picker filter; Alt+arrow nudge; canvas zoom; 12s autosave that waits while typing and skips a canvas rebuild.
No schema change. Autosave writes the same layout_json already included in SQL dumps.
cms-builder-drag-column-size.spec.ts opens Layers, selects Module A from the tree, and asserts Copy then Paste enable.
